title: 便利商店結帳
question: 店員把客人的商品一件一件刷條碼，每刷一件就輸入它的價格（一行一個）。跟「班級募款箱」不一樣：最後沒有 -1，刷完就沒有資料了。請一直輸入到沒有資料為止，輸出「共 幾 件」和「總共 幾 元」。

test_case.output:
共 3 件
總共 70 元

共 1 件
總共 120 元

共 5 件
總共 45 元
test_case.note: 題目沒有先說有幾件，要讀到沒有資料才知道

en.title: Checkout
en.question: The cashier scans a customer's items one by one and inputs each price (one per line). Unlike "Class Donation Box", there is no -1 at the end: when scanning is done, there is no more data. Keep reading until there is no more data. Output "Items: n" and "Total: x dollars".

test_case.note: The input does not say how many; read until there is no more data
